value.rationale: The first informative nonreconstructibility threshold for the previously studied three-separated three-deck is a naturally motivated gap parameter case, answering precisely when full multiplicity observations first lose injectivity. Determining all sixteen witnesses, the exact 131056 deck count, and the complete four-orbit classification is materially more informative than a routine single counterexample or recomputation of a known two-separated table. The source motivates gapped observations as a reconstruction model, and the result sharpens its generic upper bound from 41 to an exact finite threshold.
